dataset_info.name: haqsetu_eligibility_matcher_synthetic
dataset_info.description: Seed dataset for ranking schemes from free-text citizen descriptions.
dataset_info.data_origin_summary: 100% synthetic. No real citizen data. No record is a real application.

licensing.synthetic_content: Authored for the HaqSetu/Vachan project; license per project policy.
licensing.official_sources: If you add real data from data.gov.in, check each dataset's licence (many use Government Open Data License - India, GODL-India, which requires attribution). For scheme text from ministry portals, cite the portal and date and check reuse terms. Do not scrape or train on private/personal grievance data.

known_limitations: Scheme criteria are paraphrased summaries, not verified against current notifications.
Milestone durations are illustrative, not statutory, unless flagged statutory_candidate and then still needs human verification.
12 records is a seed set for schema design and smoke tests, not enough to train a model; use for few-shot, evaluation, or as a template for scaling.

schema.dataset_info.*: Dataset-level metadata: name, version, synthetic flag, licensing and limitations.
schema.scheme_catalog[].scheme_id: Stable ID (S01...) used in match labels.
schema.records[].input.text / language: Raw user text and language code (en, hi, hinglish).
schema.records[].parsed_profile: Structured entities expected to be extracted (state, district, area, age, gender, category, income, occupation, needs...). Null = not stated.
schema.records[].expected_output.needs_clarific: True when the model should ask follow-ups before ranking confidently.
schema.records[].expected_output.ranked_matches: Gold ranking. rank (1=best), relevance_grade 0-3 (3=highly relevant, 0=irrelevant; for nDCG), eligibility_signal (likely_eligible | possibly_eligible | needs_info | likely_ineligible), rationale, criteria_met / criteria_unmet / criteria_unknown.
schema.records[].expected_output.recommended_co: Scheme bundles with order (sequential | parallel) and reason.
schema.records[].expected_output.follow_up_ques: Minimal questions that would resolve unknown criteria.
schema.records[].tags: Slice tags for error analysis (hindi, negative_case, underspecified...).
schema.records[].metadata: data_origin (synthetic|real|hybrid), source_basis, source_urls, date_created, last_verified_date, confidence_score (0-1, annotator plausibility), version, verification_state, reviewer.

scheme_catalog.name: PM-KISAN
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Income support for landholding farmer families; certain categories (e.g., institutional landholders, higher-income taxpayers, some public-office holders) are excluded.

scheme_catalog.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Health cover for families in identified deprivation/occupational categories; an extension for senior citizens aged 70+ exists. Beneficiary lists drive eligibility.

scheme_catalog.name: PMAY-Gramin
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Rural housing assistance for houseless households or those in kutcha/dilapidated houses, selected from verified lists.

scheme_catalog.name: NSAP - Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Pension for elderly (60+) persons from BPL households; higher amounts for older age bands; states often top up.

scheme_catalog.name: National Scholarship Portal (pre/post-matric schemes)
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Scholarships for students from notified categories (e.g., SC/ST/OBC/minority/merit-means) subject to income ceilings and course level.

scheme_catalog.name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Cash maternity benefit for eligible pregnant/lactating women, generally for first living child; exclusions for those with other statutory maternity benefits.

scheme_catalog.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: LPG connection support for adult women from eligible poor households without an existing LPG connection in the household.

scheme_catalog.name: MGNREGA
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Up to 100 days of unskilled manual work per rural household per year on demand; adult household members must register for a job card.

scheme_catalog.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Small-savings account for a girl child (opened by guardian) below the specified age limit.

scheme_catalog.name: PM Vishwakarma
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Recognition, skill training, toolkit incentive and credit support for artisans/craftspeople in notified traditional trades.

scheme_catalog.name: Stand-Up India
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Bank loans for greenfield enterprises by SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs, within a stated loan band.

scheme_catalog.name: Atal Pension Yojana
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Pension scheme for unorganised-sector workers aged 18-40 with a bank account; contribution-based.

scheme_catalog.name: Income Certificate (State e-District service)
scheme_catalog.eligibility_summary: Certificate issued by the state revenue administration, commonly a prerequisite for scholarships and welfare schemes. Process, fee and timeline vary by state.

input.text: My family needs an income certificate for a scholarship. My son is in class 11, we are OBC, live in Lucknow, annual income about 90,000 rupees.

ranked_matches.rationale: Income certificate is a prerequisite document for the scholarship the user wants; user gave income and residence.
Class 11 OBC student with stated income may fit a post-matric/related scholarship; income ceiling and course rules must be checked.

recommended_combinations.reason: Obtain income certificate first; it is then attached to the scholarship application.

follow_up_questions: Which scholarship (state or national) has your school suggested?
Does your family have a ration card?
